headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2023, back when the AEW Women's World Title found a new home as Hikaru Shida vs. Toni Storm battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.13 ? a match that delivered ? ending the champion's reign at 4 defenses. It marked Toni Storm's 10th match with the title on the line. On the 200th episode of Dynamite, Shida overcame interference from Storm's Outcasts stablemates and reversed a Storm Zero pin attempt into her own rollup to become a two-time AEW Women's World Champion.
2024 brought us this moment: it was the first-ever encounter between MxM Collection and Private Party, topping the bill that night on Rampage, rated 6.06.

Turning the clock back to 2023: Aussie Open vs. Komander & Vikingo went to battle over the ROH World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.29 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. Komander & Vikingo was challenging for gold for the very first time. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
